title: Indices, exponentials and logarithms
summary: Index laws, negative and fractional indices, scientific notation, exponential equations, graphs, growth and decay, compound interest and logarithms.

cards.title: Negative indices
cards.tip: only the \(x\) is to the power \(-3\) in \(2x^{-3}\).

cards.title: Exponential equations
cards.rule: Write both sides with the same base, then equate the indices.

cards.title: Exponential graphs
cards.rule: \(y = a^x\) (\(a > 1\)) passes through \((0, 1)\) and gets close to \(y = 0\) but never reaches it.
lines: \(y = 2^{-x}\) is its reflection in the y-axis

cards.title: Exponential growth and decay
cards.rule: Growth: \(A = A_0(1 + r)^n\). Decay: \(A = A_0(1 - r)^n\).
lines: 2000 people growing 5% a year: \(2000 \times 1.05^3 \approx 2315\) after 3 years
Decay 10% a year: multiply by 0.9 each year

cards.title: Compound interest
cards.rule: \(A = P\left(1 + \tfrac{r}{k}\right)^{nk}\): \(k\) payments a year for \(n\) years.
lines: $5000 at 6% p.a. compounded monthly for 2 years: \(5000 \times 1.005^{24} \approx \$5635.80\)
cards.tip: divide the yearly rate by 12 for monthly.

cards.title: Logarithmic scales
cards.rule: Each step up the scale is 10 times bigger.
lines: A magnitude 6 earthquake has 10 times the amplitude of a magnitude 5
pH 3 is 10 times more acidic than pH 4

cards.title: Laws of logarithms
cards.rule: \(\log xy = \log x + \log y\), \(\log \tfrac xy = \log x - \log y\), \(\log x^n = n \log x\)

cards.title: Solving with logarithms
cards.rule: Take logs of both sides when you can't match the bases.
